newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes slightly down at intra-day low.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes slightly down at intra-day low.

text.p: The Chinese yuan ended slightly down at an intra-day low of 8.3006 against the U.S. dollar on Wednesday, in dull trading, with apparently less intervention by the central bank, traders said.
The yuan opened higher at 8.3001 from Tuesday's close of 8.3005 and moved around 8.3000 for most of the session, hitting an intra-day high of 8.2997 before ending at an intra-day low.
Trading was dull, with most done at 8.3000, traders said.
"The central bank was seen decreasing its intervention, which indicated it was satisfied with the current level of the yuan," one dealer said.
"There was one bank, possibly the Bank of China, continously selling dollars for yuan in the market but other banks sold yuan and capped its rise," a second dealer said.
Dealers expect the yuan to continue trading in a narrow range around 8.3000 on Thursday.
The yuan closed up at 7.4270 from 7.4500 against 100 Japanese yen and slightly down at 1.0737 from 1.0734 against the Hong Kong dollar.
